messages.content: I'll try that. I'm also worried about the uneven heat in the house—some rooms are sweltering and others are still cool. Do you think I should rotate them more often?

That's a smart thought. If the heat is uneven, it can be stressful for the plants. While they will likely benefit from moving them to a cooler, more consistent area, you might consider rotating them a little bit more than usual. That way, you can give all parts of the plant equal exposure to that better light, even if it's just a few hours a day!
I guess I'll give it a try. It's just frustrating because I don't want to overdo it, but I also don't want to risk them getting too hot. Do you think I should check them more often during the day?

That's a common concern—you want to keep them comfortable without stressing them out. Instead of just moving them, perhaps you could check the temperature readings in the different areas of the house periodically throughout the day. If one area is getting too warm and another is too cool, you can move them to the area that is more climate-controlled. Since you're concerned about the temperature variation, maybe check a few times a day to see which area is more stable for them.

I'll keep that in mind. Maybe I can set a reminder on my phone to check the temperature in different rooms every couple of hours. It's not too much effort, and it might help me figure out the best spot for them.
